hypotheses.reasoning: The GET /search 500s trace back to search-api, whose CatalogClient.getBatch calls fail because catalog-svc returns 500 'storage write failed'. catalog-svc is getting fast 500/503 errors from S3 us-east-1 PutObject, starting at 20:37:52. That matches when the /search 500s began, and the aws-sdk retry quota ran out. The IdP timeouts (auth-svc) only hit the POST /login path.

The identity provider started slowing down and timing out at 30s earlier (from 20:32). That filled the account-svc pool and caused /login 503s. It's a separate incident running at the same time and doesn't appear on the /search path.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check the AWS S3 us-east-1 status. Make catalog-svc's read path stop depending on synchronous S3 writes, or degrade gracefully when they fail, for example by queuing artifact uploads. Track the separate IdP timeout problem affecting /login on its own.
